description: Writes a batch of settings changes to up to 100 accounts, each account in its own transaction, and returns a per-row result (ok, unchanged, or failed with the reason) and a batch_id that revert_account_settings_batch can undo within 24 hours. idempotency_key is required: a retried request with the same key returns the first result instead of writing twice. Changes to run mode, auto-posting or review before publish affect posting right away and need confirm_sensitive:true, and that confirmation may wait for the owner's approval. Nothing is written without a preview: from a Claude or ChatGPT connection the preview_id from preview_account_settings is required, and a preview_id that does not match the changes is refused. Applies after the user has seen the preview and confirmed it. 繁中：套用批次變更（每帳號一個交易、24 小時內可復原），敏感欄位要 confirm_sensitive，目錄連線一定要先預覽並帶 preview_id。

changes.description: Up to 100 entries: { account_id, set: { column: value }, base?: { column: value you saw } }. Columns and allowed values: list_account_settings columns, or https://mindthread.tw/accounts/bulk/rules

base.description: column key → value you read; a cell changed since then is refused instead of overwritten

confirm_sensitive.description: true when the batch changes run mode, auto-posting or review before publish

csv.description: Instead of changes: a CSV in the website download format (UTF-8)

idempotency_key.description: 8-200 characters; reuse the same key when retrying the same request

preview_id.description: preview_id from preview_account_settings (required from Claude and ChatGPT connections)

reason.description: Optional note stored with the batch, up to 200 characters

name: apply_account_settings
title: Apply bulk settings changes
